# AEOCheck - AI Search Readiness Scanner
# https://aeocheck.co
# llms.txt v1.0

## About
AEOCheck is a free AI search readiness scanner that audits any public webpage 
for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) signals. It checks metadata, schema markup, 
heading structure, content clarity, trust signals, and performance — the exact 
signals ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI use to understand and cite pages.

## What We Do
- Scan any public URL in 60 seconds
- Return an AI visibility score (0-100)
- Identify missing schema, weak metadata, and content gaps
- Generate prioritized fixes for AI search readiness
- Export client-ready PDF reports

## Target Users
Agencies, SEO freelancers, Webflow developers, founders, small business owners

- Agency Lite: $39/month, 30 reports/month
